name: kspcid-cloud-publication

service_gate.required: Catalyst Circuits available in the selected project data center
service_gate.function_constraint: Every functional state must invoke a Basic I/O function

states.name: Validation Failed
states.reason: Manifest, checksum, row-count, or allowlist validation failed

states.name: Publication Failed
states.reason: No production marker is written; previous published dataset remains active

idempotency.data_store: All four imports are upserts against unique keys
idempotency.stratus: Objects use checksummed immutable keys; runtime uploads use overwrite only after checksum validation
idempotency.cache: The warmer overwrites deterministic keys with a two-day TTL
idempotency.publish: The production marker is written only after all verification states pass
idempotency.retry: A retry may re-run any state without duplicating rows or changing a previously published dataset

note: All seven Basic I/O function packages are built locally. This remains an audited workflow contract, not claimed to be Catalyst Code View JSON: remote Function IDs and the console-compiled Code View representation only exist after owner project initialization.
